_comment: Onboarding observable signals for founder-control-room OODA Observe layer.

kpi_queries.activation_rate: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE stage = 'activated') * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS rate FROM user_onboarding_state
kpi_queries.stage_funnel: SELECT stage, COUNT(*) as users FROM user_onboarding_state GROUP BY stage
kpi_queries.avg_time_to_activate_by_role: SELECT role, AVG(identity_to_activated_secs) FROM user_onboarding_state WHERE activated_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY role
kpi_queries.activation_actions_breakdown: SELECT activation_action, COUNT(*) FROM user_onboarding_state WHERE activated_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY activation_action
